description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called SessionMenuLabelView used to display session data with visual indicators, along with an extension to EnvironmentValues for a custom environment key menuItemHighlighted.

classes.name: SessionMenuLabelView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that displays session information with a bar indicating token usage and labels with highlighted styles based on environment state.

methods.name: body
methods.description: The main view composition constructing the layout with token usage bar and session details text, styled based on whether the item is highlighted.
